text: The key to a good life is never feeling pain.
I am not quick to leave situations that make me feel uneasy.
source_text: I'm quick to leave any situation that makes me feel uneasy.

text: When unpleasant memories come to me, I do not try to push them out of my mind.
source_text: When unpleasant memories come to me, I try to put them out of my mind.

text: I feel disconnected from my emotions.
I won't do something until I absolutely have to.
Fear or anxiety won't stop me from doing something important.
I would not give up much just to avoid feeling bad.
source_text: I would give up a lot not to feel bad.

text: I will still do something even if there is a chance that it will upset me.
source_text: I rarely do something if there is a chance that it will upset me.

text: It's hard for me to know what I'm feeling.
I do not put off unpleasant tasks for as long as possible.
source_text: I try to put off unpleasant tasks for as long as possible.

text: I do not go out of my way to avoid uncomfortable situations.
source_text: I go out of my way to avoid uncomfortable situations.

text: One of my big goals is to be free from painful emotions.
I do not work hard to keep upsetting feelings away.
source_text: I work hard to keep out upsetting feelings.

text: If I have any doubts about doing something, I just won't do it.
